page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized bare-metal instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a baseline frequency of 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance type does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring reliance on external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and cloud services.

The high resource density of 1024.0 GB of RAM combined with 128 dedicated cores makes this instance class suitable for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and heavy data processing pipelines that require substantial memory capacity without the need for local NVMe drives or specialized GPU acceleration.
